verified: The supervisor preflights the protected local API, starts pinned Prometheus and Grafana on loopback, waits for both readiness endpoints, and exits after a bounded smoke interval.
The supervisor test uses an isolated PAPER API, state directory, dynamic ports, and test credentials; it confirms credentials are absent from child environments and output.
The temporary per-run configuration and credential directory is removed on normal shutdown, and Prometheus and Grafana ports are released.
The native Prometheus/Grafana acceptance checks protected scraping and queries, alert hold and recovery, authenticated dashboard provisioning, and explicit source failure.
Ruff lint and format checks pass for the new launcher and tests.
limitations: The supervisor is an opt-in Windows single-operator local workflow; Linux and Windows service installation are not implemented.
The OTel collector and PAPER API must be started separately. No external alert delivery or metrics/log correlation is provided.
Forced termination or power loss can leave a per-run directory with bootstrap secrets; operators must inspect and remove stale run directories after confirming no launcher is active.
No independent review or broader P00-P13 acceptance was performed; all P00-P13 release gates remain open.
